summary.text: Tammy Schmersal-Burgess is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 77 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her profession as hair stylist.

paragraphs.text: Tammy Schmersal-Burgess lives in Mexico, Maine, and her career experience includes working as a barber stylist.
She assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 6, 2022, succeeding Michael D. Perkins.
In 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Environment and Natural Resources Committee.
